description: This Java class MidiEventScheduler manages MIDI events by scheduling and handling MIDI messages via Android's MidiReceiver. It provides mechanisms for event creation, pooling for optimized memory use, and integration with Android's MIDI framework.
external_methods: MidiReceiver.onSend(byte[] msg, int offset, int count, long timestamp)

classes.name: MidiEventScheduler
classes.description: Extends EventScheduler to handle scheduling of MIDI events, including event pooling for performance optimization.

classes.name: MidiEvent
classes.description: Represents a scheduled MIDI event containing message data and timestamp.

methods.name: createScheduledEvent
methods.description: Creates or reuses a MidiEvent with specified MIDI message data and timestamp.

methods.name: addEventToPool
methods.description: Returns an event to the pool for reuse, if it matches criteria.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the MidiReceiver instance used to receive MIDI messages.
